title: prospects.jsonl record
description: One enriched prospect. gtme-score gates sending on record_status, so a status nobody earned is a message to a stranger. `verified` therefore requires evidence a human profile was actually opened: a verbatim role line, plus the two sections you can only have read by scrolling the profile.

record_status.description: `unchecked` is the honest default when a name was resolved from a source that is not the profile. It is a legitimate intermediate state; what it must never be is absent, because an absent status reads exactly like a passed one.

allOf.description: Where a profile loaded at all, the quote is what makes the status checkable - for wrong_person it IS the proof of collision. Only not_found may leave it null, having had nothing to quote.
No grandfather clause anywhere in the record.

identityCheck.description: Proof the profile was OPENED, not inferred from a name. Same field and same job as competitors[].identity in company.schema.json.

pulled.description: Date the profile was actually loaded. Doubles as the staleness clock.

says.description: The current-role line, verbatim. Not the headline, which is self-written marketing. A reader holds this against `title` and `company` and sees a mismatch without redoing the work. null only where nothing loaded to quote.
